label: rare reset-gate spike at fixed copy-phase positions of length-9 sequences (recall 3 / last output)
explanation: Very sparse (about 0.03% of steps, magnitude max 0.005). Fires only in the copy phase, never in the original or delimiter phases; 94% of mass is on L=9 sequences, concentrated at t=12 (recall_idx 3, about 53% of mass) and t=17 (the final output, recall_idx 8, about 25%), with spillover at t=11, 13 and 16. Always on a copied input (in_first=0). The position predicate captures about 94% of mass but precision is under 1%: only about 1 in 100 L=9 sequences fire at those steps. Which ones fire depends weakly on token identity (in_tok 2/b/y/j/g, prev_tok v/y/n/a, out_tok h/1/y/m/3, each with about 5x lift), but token conjunctions only reach F1 of about 0.12, so the selection is not captured. Magnitude is highest at t=12 and t=17 in L=9; I did not verify any other magnitude modulators. Does not fire for L<=6.
